integrity: The proof is an exact reduction of the published coordinate update to an infinite product. A genuine two-objective quadratic realizes the exact secant relation inside the source scalarization, and the finite-energy and Q-linear consequences follow from elementary convergent-product and geometric-series estimates.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns coordinatewise asymptotic identification by the fixed-regularization diagonal metric module under exact constant-curvature secant data. It does not claim failure of the full algorithm, does not treat curvature outside the projection interval, and does not optimize a time-varying regularization schedule.
title: Finite path energy freezes the DVM-R3TCG diagonal secant metric
